question: A speed of 126 km/hr is the same as:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To convert any speed from kilometres per hour (km/hr) to metres per second (m/sec) directly, multiply the given value by 5/18.

Speed in m/sec = 126 × (5/18)

Speed = 7 × 5 = 35 m/sec

**∴ The correct answer is 35 m/sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the object = 126 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

1 kilometre = 1000 metres

1 hour = 3600 seconds

Speed in m/sec = Speed in km/hr × (1000 / 3600) = Speed in km/hr × (5/18)
